# MIND Detective 0.1.0

Initial repository and plugin release for the systematic lost-item search assistant.

## Included

- deterministic Case Controller;
- provenance-aware statements and uncertainty-preserving timeline;
- mode-aware reconstruction/search guard;
- durable physical SearchCheck log;
- categorical one-next-action planner;
- explicit case-local save/resume/delete;
- high-risk forgotten-action boundary;
- handoff/outcome artifacts and exactly five production skills;
- exact requirement traceability, adversarial eval fixtures, bilingual docs, CI/freshness/boundary controls.

## Limits

This release does not restore memory, diagnose a forgetting mechanism, provide calibrated location probabilities, or prove that a generic LLM host intercepted every candidate utterance. No Web/PWA, connector, cloud persistence, or cross-case learning is included.
